note: mocked=true means NOT integrated (stub/fixture). mocked=false means real live integration.

components.name: ORTHOAI M Gateway IPC Server (socat listener)
components.transport: named pipe ortho-ai (\\.\pipe\ortho-ai on Windows / Unix socket /tmp/CoreFxPipe_ortho-ai on Linux)
components.details: socat listener forks one process per connection; reads one MessageEnvelope line, streams InferenceEvent lines ending Done=true. Verified by ortho32-ai-gateway tests/e2e.sh (15 checks) against a mock provider; NOT yet verified against the real C# host. Windows named pipes are not served (Linux/macOS Unix socket only).

components.name: Inference Handler (Anthropic/OpenAI) in M
components.transport: HTTPS to provider via curl + pipe back
components.details: Calls the real provider endpoints with curl (body and credential via 0600 files, no shell interpolation of request data). Non-streaming: one Chunk with the reply text, then Done. Missing key yields an Error event. Verified against a local mock of the provider APIs only; real OpenAI/Anthropic calls not exercised.

components.name: Models Catalog Handler
components.details: The M gateway has no live GET /v1/models handler; the catalog is a static table initialised by INIT^ORTROUTE. The previous TypeScript handler no longer exists.

components.name: ORTHOBridge C Simulator
components.details: Real 4x4 matmul (manual or cblas_sgemm), cycles=768 architectural constant, SHA-256 of actual result bytes as traceRoot/resultHash

components.name: ORTHOHost C#/.NET IPC Router + EventBus + Session
components.transport: named pipe ortho-ai client to gateway
components.details: Not verified in this slice. Gateway implements server side matching ORTHOHost InferenceService spec, ready for host to connect as client.

components.name: ORTHORouter canonical routes/intents
components.details: Not implemented here. Pipe envelope includes source/target/action routing fields for future router.

components.name: ORTHOEventBus streaming + correlation
components.details: TS side real correlationId streaming implemented. C# EventBus integration not verified; marked mocked until E2E with host.

components.name: Swift Desktop Client
components.details: No Swift client in repo. Pipe contract documented for Swift to connect.

components.name: Gateway socket round-trip test
components.transport: in-process net client to pipe server
components.details: socat -> bridge -> YottaDB -> curl -> mock provider; run with `npm run test:e2e` in ortho32-ai-gateway (needs YottaDB, socat, jq, curl, node). The previous tests/integration/test_pipe_roundtrip.ts no longer exists.
